items.headline: Daedalus Special Acquisition Corp. Signs Letter of Intent with HUBX Yazılım Hizmetleri Anonim Şirketi
items.summary: London, United Kingdom, Sept. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Daedalus Special Acquisition Corp. (Nasdaq: DSAC) (the 'Company”), today announced the signing of a non-binding Letter of Intent with HUBX Yazılım Hizmetleri Anonim Şirketi ('HubX” or the 'Target”), for a proposed business combination through which HubX plans to become a public company with its securities listed on The Nasdaq Stock Market.  HubX, one of the largest consumer AI companies globally, is based in Turkiye, and designs, builds, and scales AI-powered consumer applications on a global basis.
